verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official first-party MCP server that lets users work with Adyen through natural language from their chosen LLM client [adyen-pos-docs-20, adyen-pos-docs-13, adyen-pos-probe-4]. That makes natural-language operation a genuine product capability. However, the evidence frames it as a developer aid for building payment solutions and never shows which in-person operations it covers, such as terminal management, refunds or payments on terminals. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools for in-person and terminal operations, details on what actions can be performed by natural-language command, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
